title: Design Custom Basketball Uniforms (2026)
verdict: To design custom basketball uniforms in 2026, open Wooter's builder, pick a basketball style and change the colors, logo and team name while the preview updates. If you would rather hand it off, Wooter's designers draw the uniform for free and send a mockup in 1 to 2 business days.

Boombah's builder is the closest alternative and covers reversible sets. Custom Ink's Design Lab works for print on a stock jersey. Champro and Nike Team have builders whose designs are ordered through a dealer.
steps_title: How to design a basketball uniform

steps.name: Pick the cut
steps.text: Decide on V-neck, round neck or sleeved, and whether the set is single-sided or reversible. The cut decides how much space the design gets.

steps.name: Set the colors
steps.text: Choose a dark and a light version if you play home and away. High school rules want the torso in one solid color, so keep patterns to the side panels and shorts.

steps.name: Place the name and numbers
steps.text: Team name across the chest, number below it and on the back. Leave room: front numbers need at least 4 inches of height under high school rules, back numbers 6.

steps.name: Match the shorts
steps.text: Carry one stripe, panel or logo from the jersey onto the shorts. One shared element is enough.

steps.name: Enter the roster
steps.text: Add each player's name, number and size. On Wooter the roster copies to shorts and warmups.

steps.name: Approve the mockup
steps.text: Check spelling, numbers and colors on the proof. Nothing is made until you approve it.

why: A basketball uniform is two garments that have to read as one. Most design mistakes come from treating the shorts as an afterthought.
Wooter's builder starts from 500+ finished styles, so the proportions are already right and you are changing colors and marks, not drawing from zero. The price shows as you go.
When the builder is not enough, the design service is free. Send colors, a logo and two or three uniforms you like.

faq.q: Can I design home and away at once?
faq.a: Yes. Design one, then swap the colors for the second. A reversible set gives you both in one jersey.

faq.q: What makes a uniform legal for high school games?
faq.a: NFHS rules call for a single solid color on the torso, a front number at least 4 inches high and a back number at least 6. Numbers use only the digits 0 through 5. Your state association has the full list.

faq.q: How much does the design cost?
faq.a: Nothing at Wooter. The builder and the design service are both free, and you pay when you order.

faq.q: How long after the design is done?
faq.a: Plan on three to four weeks from the day you approve the proof. Wooter offers rush production if you are short on time.
